mapper.insert: INSERT INTO insurance_simulation (sim_id, pet_id, breed, age, medical_history, estimated_annual_cost, premium, deductible, break_even_year, recommendation) VALUES (#{simId}, #{petId}, #{breed}, #{age}, #{medicalHistory}, #{estimatedAnnualCost}, #{premium}, #{deductible}, #{breakEvenYear}, #{recommendation})

INSERT INTO insurance_claim (claim_id, pet_id, member_id, receipt_image_url, extracted_data, hospital_name, treatment_date, total_amount, claim_status) VALUES (#{claimId}, #{petId}, #{memberId}, #{receiptImageUrl}, #{extractedData}, #{hospitalName}, #{treatmentDate}, #{totalAmount}, #{claimStatus})
mapper.update: UPDATE insurance_claim SET hospital_name = #{hospitalName}, treatment_date = #{treatmentDate}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, claim_status = #{claimStatus}, claim_document_url = #{claimDocumentUrl}, extracted_data = #{extractedData}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE claim_id = #{claimId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM insurance_claim WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
